shared_elements: row of repeated units forming a horizontal band (rosettes in A, arch/loop forms and vertical strokes in B)
horizontal register line dividing the surface
figures aligned along a common ground line facing one direction
justification: Both surfaces organise profile figures along a horizontal ground line beneath a band of small repeated units (rosette frieze in A, arched forms and vertical strokes in B), which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a smoothly finished, naturalistically modelled procession of humans and a camel on a flat wall panel, whereas B is a coarse, schematic, flat-relief animal imagery on a rough free-standing block, so the manner of rendering and the overall impression differ sharply.
